results.name: Weiner & Weiner, P.C.

wrong_claims.claim: The page has no contact details in its text and no email address - 'a visitor has to copy the number from a directory'
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The Contact section of the same single page publishes the full address (385 Cranbury Road, Suite 7, East Brunswick, NJ 08816), phone (732) 565-9400, fax (732) 565-0090, an email address linked three times as a mailto, and a Facebook page link. What is missing is a form and any click-to-call (zero tel: links); the phone is plain text. The earlier review appears to have read an extraction that dropped the contact <ul>.

results.notes: Status re-confirmed: firm operating, 1996 founding, Jay A. Weiner sole attorney, East Brunswick office. HTTPS re-tested in Chrome: net::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID, and http:// also lands on the certificate warning, so the site is effectively unreachable for normal visitors and crawlers. Page is one long brochure page with anchor nav only, 0 forms, 0 JSON-LD, no tel: link, viewport meta present and no horizontal overflow at ~390-405 px, so 'phone_layout: broken' is better described as 'phone not clickable'. Google profile re-checked: Weiner & Weiner, P.C., 4.3 from 6 reviews, 'Claim this business' and 'Add hours' shown, website link present - unclaimed state confirmed. robots.txt returns 404 even over http, so 'not retrievable' is right. Gap stays large because of the certificate failure, but since phone and email are published I would not score the gap a full 5, and evidence should drop because a central detail was read wrong.

results.name: Oral Surgery Group (Dental Implants & Wisdom Teeth)

wrong_claims.claim: The contact page has no contact form at all (zero input fields), so every inquiry must be a phone call
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The page's only <form> is the site search, but the contact page embeds a third-party Liine request form in an iframe (forms.liine.com/231633500869962, rendered roughly 745x539 on screen) with Last/First Name, Email, Phone, 'scheduled with us before?', Preferred Location and Comments fields. Online enquiries can therefore be submitted; what is genuinely broken is the dead 'Schedule Consult' CTA and the 404 Forms nav item.

wrong_claims.claim: The practice has 1,461 Google reviews at 4.9
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The Birdeye mirror of the Google profile now reads 4.9 with 1,489 reviews; the figure is drifting upward, not a fixed 1,461.

results.notes: Confirmed separately: 'Schedule Consult' appears three times as an <a> with no href; clicking one at desktop width changed neither the URL nor the DOM and opened no modal. /forms/ soft-redirects to /404 ('404: Page Not Found'). Nav parents 'Forms' and 'About' have null hrefs while the working Doctor Referral (govos) and Patient Registration (mysecurepractice) links sit in the menu - confirmed. robots.txt is 'User-agent: *' plus one sitemap line. LocalBusiness JSON-LD contains streetAddress, telephone, openingHours and GeoCoordinates. At 390 px the first tel: link is ~9,100 px down the page and the header shows only Search and Menu, matching the mobile complaint; no horizontal overflow. No '$' figures or insurance/financing wording on the East Brunswick page. Google listing: claimed (no 'Claim this business'), 4.9, hours, phone and site link. Gap/scores: with a working (if buried) enquiry form the gap is smaller than scored and the evidence weaker, since the iframe was missed.

results.name: Busch and Busch, LLP

wrong_claims.what_is_true: A Google Business Profile exists: 'Busch & Busch', 2875 US-1, North Brunswick, Attorney, rated 3.0, showing 'Claim this business' and 'Add hours', linking to buschlaw.com. Review count is not shown in the signed-out view. So there is a GBP and it is unclaimed, with a low rating - which strengthens rather than weakens the record.

results.notes: HTTPS re-tested: Chrome shows the 'Your connection is not private' interstitial and a raw client gets 'certificate has expired'; http:// redirects into the same failing certificate. After proceeding past the warning, the page confirms: document.title 'Busch and Busch, LLP', 0 h1, no viewport meta, exactly 8 images, 3 mailto links (mrb/rjb/beb@buschlaw.com), 0 tel: links, 0 forms, 0 JSON-LD, literal 'Title 1 / Title 2 / Title 3 / Title 4' and 'SECTION 4' headings, address 2875 U.S. Highway #1 at Finnegans Lane, phone 732 821-2300, fax 732 821-5588, single page with in-page anchors. Lawyers.com re-checked: 1.0 overall from 1 client review (Jan 2023, residential real estate, complaints about fees and non-response) and a Martindale peer score of 4.7 from 7 peer reviews. Gap 5 is right, but evidence should drop because the Google profile was missed; the 3.0 rating and unclaimed profile belong in the top issues.

results.name: Yuhas Plumbing & Heating
results.notes: Everything checked holds. Site loads over HTTPS with a CALL YUHAS PLUMBING / (732) 257-7013 button and 6 tel: links; there are no forms at all (the only two inputs are range sliders for before/after images), contact is mailto:YuhasPlumbers@gmail.com, nav is one-page anchors (/#services, /home#reviews, /home#contact), h1 reads 'No job is too small', copyright is 2025, and LocalBusiness JSON-LD carries the 33 Jackson Street address, telephone and email. No hours anywhere in the page text. /contact returns HTTP 404 from the Squarespace host. Google re-checked: Yuhas Plumbing & Heating, 4.2 from 28 reviews, with 'Claim this business', 'Add hours' and 'Add website' all shown, phone (732) 257-7013 - unclaimed state confirmed. Scores gap 5 / pay 4 / ease 5 / evidence 4 are reasonable.

results.name: Kelly & Company Hair Design
results.notes: Checked and holding: home page <title> is empty (a single space in the raw HTML), no meta description on home, footer links point at about.html / services.html / contact.html / booking.html and the header logo at /images/logo.png - all return HTTP 404 (about.html, booking.html and the logo tested directly). The working pages are /about-us/, /services/ and /booking/. Booking is a Contact Form 7 request form with name, phone, email, service, date and time fields plus 'We will call to confirm'; no booking platform. JSON-LD on home and services is only WebPage/BreadcrumbList/WebSite - no LocalBusiness. No '$' prices on home or /services/. Hours are real text (Tue-Fri 10-8, Sat 9-4, Mon closed). Maps: 'Kelly & Company Hair Design', 4.8, hair salon, 'Claim this business' shown, but the profile already has hours, phone, website and photos - so the 'claim and complete' opportunity is really just 'claim'. Scores are defensible, though gap_size 5 is slightly generous for a salon whose only real defects are metadata/links.

results.name: Hollander Electric Co LLC

wrong_claims.claim: Page titles carry a single emoji character as their only text ('document.title returned only an emoji')
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The emoji is an artefact of the browser session's tab-title handling, not the site. The raw HTML has a genuinely empty <title></title>, so the substance of the finding (no service or town text in any page title, no meta description) stands, but it is an empty title rather than an emoji one.

results.notes: Re-verified: raw HTML title empty, no meta description, 0 JSON-LD on the home page, 3 forms with hero/residential/quote fields (name, phone, service select, message), 8 tel: links, licence data in the top bar. Town pages: 30 distinct /electrician/<town> links on the home page (record says 31 - minor). Google: Hollander Electric, 4.8 from 207 reviews, claimed, hours, phone, owner-added photos ('By owner, a day ago'), no 'Claim this business' - so the 'claimed, complete, active profile' assessment is right. Scores gap 3 / pay 5 / ease 5 / evidence 5 remain reasonable; the only error is the emoji detail.

results.name: First Rehab
results.notes: Re-verified: the Locations page shows only 'First Rehab Lakewood' with 1352 River Avenue and footer 'in Lakewood, NJ'; both header tel: links are tel:+17328842020 (Lakewood), not the Spotswood number; page-sitemap.xml has no Spotswood page; the scheduling form's Location dropdown offers only 'Lakewood' and the form is behind reCAPTCHA. Home title does name both towns ('...Lakewood & Spotswood, NJ'), JSON-LD is a Yoast WebPage/BreadcrumbList/WebSite/Organization graph with no Spotswood NAP, copyright is 2026. Maps shows the Spotswood listing 'First Rehab Physical Therapy', 5.0 from 10 reviews, 404 Main St # A, (732) 251-6640 - plus a second, unreviewed listing 'First Rehab Outpatient Therapy Provider Spotswood', i.e. a duplicate profile the record did not flag. Scores gap 4 / pay 4 / ease 5 / evidence 5 are reasonable.

results.name: CME Associates (now Artheon)

wrong_claims.claim: The site's robots.txt (Cloudflare content signals) disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot and most AI training crawlers while allowing Googlebot, OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot
wrong_claims.what_is_true: artheon.com/robots.txt is a plain Yoast block: 'User-agent: *' with an empty Disallow, plus one sitemap line. Every crawler, including GPTBot and ClaudeBot, is allowed - there is no Cloudflare content-signals policy.

wrong_claims.claim: Page titles carry a stray emoji prefix ('🐴 Home - Artheon')
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The emoji comes from the browser tab session, not the site; the real title is 'Home - Artheon', with a vague slogan meta description ('transformative infrastructure solutions...').

results.notes: Contact page re-checked directly: 7 tel: links (Neptune, Camden, East Brunswick, Barnegat, Cape May Court House, Berlin and a 646 NYC number), no mailto links, no street addresses, no contact form (the only form is the cookie-consent panel plus a search box), literal 'Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet' post titles and visible spam comments. /market-sectors/ serves the theme's 'Page not found - Artheon' template, so the 404 complaint holds. Maps still shows 'CME Associates', Engineering consultant, cmeusa1.com, 3.9, with 'Add missing information' / 'Add a photo' prompts - rebrand gap confirmed. Ability to pay and ease are fine; evidence drops because of the robots.txt error, which also removes one of the stated reasons for the low findable score.

data_gaps: Google Maps shows review counts only for some listings in the signed-out limited view; Kelly & Company, Oral Surgery Group, CME Associates/Artheon and Busch & Busch show a rating but no count, so those review totals could not be re-verified from Google directly.
The Oral Surgery Group contact form is a third-party iframe (forms.liine.com); I read its fields but did not submit anything, so it is unconfirmed whether a submission actually reaches the practice.

Busch and Busch's site content was only readable after clicking through Chrome's certificate interstitial; there is no HTTP fallback, so crawler behaviour is judged from the certificate failure alone.
Screenshots timed out in this browser session, so the 390 px checks were done by resizing the viewport and reading element geometry and overflow instead of visually inspecting rendered pages.
First Rehab's Spotswood Google listing did not expose its website URL in the limited Maps view, so the claim that the profile links to first-rehab.com was not independently re-confirmed.
